北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气浓，能见度低，请注意交通安全，出行要慢哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog in Beijing, low visibility. Please drive safely and take it slow!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪雾蒙蒙，路上慢行，注意安全。出门带伞备不时之需。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Foggy in Cixi, drive slowly and safely. Carry an umbrella just in case.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海雾气重，能见度低，早安出行请减速，注意安全。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog in Shanghai, low visibility. Drive slowly this morning and stay safe.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阵雨中，湿度大，记得带伞，注意防潮哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Showers in Guangzhou, high humidity. Remember your umbrella and prevent dampness.
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降8℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感温暖，湿度高。出门注意防晒和补水。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Shenzhen, feels warm and humid. Remember sunscreen and hydration.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州大雾，路上慢行，注意安全。湿度大，小心湿滑。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog in Hangzhou, drive slowly and safely. High humidity, watch for slipperiness.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾弥漫，湿度 100%，能见度差，出行请谨慎！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Dense fog in Nanjing, 100% humidity, poor visibility. Please travel with caution!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴好，湿度高，体感舒适。外出记得补水哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Chengdu, high humidity, feels comfortable. Remember to hydrate when out.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉雾气浓，湿度 100%，能见度低，路上慢行。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Dense fog in Wuhan, 100% humidity, low visibility. Drive slowly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，早晚温差大，注意添减衣物，别着凉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Xi'an, big temperature difference. Dress appropriately to avoid colds.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温适宜。出门记得带伞，以防阵雨。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Chongqing, pleasant temperature. Bring an umbrella for possible showers.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有雾，气温较低，体感寒凉。出行务必保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Foggy in Harbin, low temperature, feels chilly. Be sure to stay warm when out.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感微凉。多穿一件，小心着凉。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Shenyang, feels a bit cool. Wear an extra layer to avoid colds.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感微凉。早晚温差大，记得添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Kunming, feels a bit cool. Big temperature difference, remember layers.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，湿度大。出行注意安全，小心湿滑。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Foggy in Xiamen, high humidity. Travel safely and watch for slipperiness.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛雾气重，体感较凉。出行注意交通安全，多保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Heavy fog in Qingdao, feels cool. Drive safely and stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，体感寒凉。出行注意安全，多穿衣物保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Foggy in Dalian, feels chilly. Travel safely and wear warm clothes.
